name: analizador-de-comics
description: Tracker local de comics de Spider-Man y lineas relacionadas, con SQLite, UI y revision por Telegram.

scripts.test: node tests/marvel.test.js && node tests/panini.test.js && node tests/universo-marvel.test.js && node tests/catalog.test.js && node tests/service.test.js && node tests/runtime.test.js && node --test tests/http-security.test.js tests/server.test.js tests/ui-security.test.js tests/telegram.test.js && python -B tests/telegram_bot_test.py
scripts.test:python-coverage: python -B -m coverage run --branch --data-file=data/security-review/python.coverage --include=src/telegram_bot.py tests/telegram_bot_test.py && python -B -m coverage report --data-file=data/security-review/python.coverage --fail-under=100
